title: OpenAI's Q3 results and Nvidia's scandal impact on the AI ecosystem
summary:
Deidre Bosa is joined by Khosla Ventures Founder Vinod Khosla to discuss OpenAI's (OPAI.PVT) Q3 results from an investor perspective, how OpenAI compares with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT), and how the Nvidia scandal impacts the AI ecosystem.

Deidre Bosa then sits down with OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar to discuss OpenAI's push into enterprise AI, their 'dots' rollout, and the global AI model race.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

title: Nvidia in the hot seat, Anthropic to test the IPO market, hotter-than-expected US inflation
summary:
Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in on the alleged plot to spy on Nvidia's Jensen Huang, why retail investors should wait for Anthropic's IPO instead of chasing private markets, and what the next moves should be for the Federal Reserve after the latest inflation print. 

Today's panel includes Drew Pettit, Roundhill Investments' Chief Investment Strategist; Robert Schein, Blanke Schein Wealth Management's chief investment officer; and Christine Short, TMX Wall Street Horizon's Head of Corporate Event Research.
